meta.title: Total Vendor Score generated after approval
gaps: Approve the scored vendor as the approver and open the vendor's profile or Onboarding Details screen.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Approve the scored vendor as the approver and open the vendor's profile or Onboarding Details screen.

args.need: sign in as the approver, approve the scored vendor, and open the vendor's profile or Onboarding Details screen showing the generated Total Vendor Score

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform the approver workflow or navigate to the vendor onboarding profile.
